site.name: slack
site.summary: slack-clone Clone of the Slack marketing + pricing multi-page site. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Home: hero ("Made for people. Built for productivity."), product demo animation, customer logos, product modules (Channels / Huddles / Canvas / Workflow / AI), customer stories | | `pricing.html` | Pricing: four columns Free / Pro / Business+ / Enterprise+, yearly / monthly toggle, feature comparison table (message history, Slack Connect, Workflow Builder, AI, Support, etc.), FAQ | | `features.html` | Feature detail page: modules for Channels / Canvas / Clips / Huddles / Workflows / AI |

run_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the Slack marketing + pricing site, focusing on primary flows (pricing, sign-up, features) and adjacent pages, validating interactions, layout, and mobile responsiveness.
run_plan.summary: Start with the home page (index.html), explore primary flows (pricing, sign-up, features) in phases, validate interactables (links, buttons, forms), check layout warnings (small tap targets), and repeat critical checks in mobile viewport. Cover all known HTML pages, exercise visible controls, and validate mobile responsiveness.
assumptions: All pages load without errors (per prescan)
Layout warnings (small tap targets) are consistent across pages
risk_hotspots: small_tap_target warnings (low severity but consistent across pages)

phases.title: Home Page & Navigation
phases.objective: Validate home page (index.html) interactables, navigation links, and mobile layout warnings.
key_checks: Click navigation links (Features, Solutions, Enterprise, Pricing, Sign in, Talk to sales, Get started free)
Verify mobile layout warnings (small tap targets) for top interactables
Check hero section interactables (Get started free, Talk to sales)
exit_criteria: All home page interactables clicked, navigation links verified, mobile layout warnings documented

phases.title: Pricing Flow
phases.objective: Explore pricing page (pricing.html), validate plan selection, billing toggle, and feature comparison.
key_checks: Click 'Toggle billing period' (monthly/annual)
Explore plan cards (Free, Pro, Business+, Enterprise+)
Interact with feature comparison table (All, Productivity, AI toggles)
Check 'Get started free' and 'Contact sales' buttons
exit_criteria: Pricing page interactables exercised, billing toggle validated, feature comparison explored

phases.title: Sign-Up & Sign-In
phases.objective: Validate sign-up (get-started.html) and sign-in (signin.html) flows, including forms and social login options.
key_checks: Interact with get-started.html form (Work email, Continue, social login buttons)
Validate signin.html form (Email, Password, social login, 'Create an account', 'Forgot your password?')
Check mobile layout for form inputs (tap target size)
exit_criteria: Sign-up and sign-in forms interacted with, social login options verified, mobile form layout documented

phases.title: Features & Solutions
phases.objective: Explore features (features.html) and solutions (solutions.html) pages, validate feature modules and solution categories.
key_checks: Click feature modules (Channels, Slack Connect, Huddles, etc.) in features.html
Explore solution categories (Engineering, IT, Customer Service, etc.) in solutions.html
Verify navigation back to home/pricing
Check mobile layout warnings for feature/solution links
exit_criteria: All major feature modules and solution categories explored, navigation verified, mobile layout documented

phases.title: Adjacent Pages (About, Contact, Enterprise, Resources, Trust)
phases.objective: Explore adjacent pages (about.html, contact.html, enterprise.html, resources.html, trust.html), validate content and interactables.
key_checks: Interact with about.html (company info, careers)
Validate contact.html form (input fields, submission button)
Explore enterprise.html (security, scale, AI features)
Check resources.html (Help Centre, What's New, Developers)
Verify trust.html (security, compliance, encryption)
exit_criteria: All adjacent pages explored, interactables exercised, content validated

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness
phases.objective: Repeat critical checks (navigation, pricing, sign-up) in mobile viewport, validate layout and interactables.
key_checks: Recheck navigation links in mobile viewport
Validate pricing page plan selection and billing toggle in mobile
Verify sign-up form (get-started.html) input fields and buttons in mobile
Document mobile-specific layout warnings (small tap targets)
exit_criteria: Critical checks repeated in mobile viewport, mobile layout validated, warnings documented

coverage_targets.features: Exercise most visible controls (links, buttons, forms) on key pages (index, pricing, features, get-started, signin)
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (navigation, pricing, sign-up) in mobile viewport, validate layout and interactables

notes: Max steps (80) should be sufficient to cover all phases, with ~10-15 steps per phase. Prioritize primary flows (pricing, sign-up) and critical interactables.

prescan_summary.title: Trust & Security – Slack
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: slack Features Solutions Enterprise Pricing Sign in Talk to sales Get started free Trust & Security Security isn't just a feature — it's the foundation of everything we build. Data Encryption All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256. Your conversations and files are protected at every layer. Compliance Certifications Slack maintains SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and CSA certifications. We also support HIPAA and FedRAMP compliance. Enterprise Key Management Control your own encryption keys with Slack EKM, powered by AWS KMS. Revoke access to data at any time with full audit trails. Data Loss Prevention Native DLP scans messages and files in Slack Connect to prevent sharing of confidential, malicious or personally identifiable content. Identity & Access SAML-based SSO, SCIM provisioning, two-factor authentication, session management

observation.title: Trust & Security – Slack
observation.visible_text: slack Features Solutions Enterprise Pricing Sign in Talk to sales Get started free Trust & Security Security isn't just a feature — it's the foundation of everything we build. Data Encryption All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256. Your conversations and files are protected at every layer. Compliance Certifications Slack maintains SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and CSA certifications. We also support HIPAA and FedRAMP compliance. Enterprise Key Management Control your own encryption keys with Slack EKM, powered by AWS KMS. Revoke access to data at any time with full audit trails. Data Loss Prevention Native DLP scans messages and files in Slack Connect to prevent sharing of confidential, malicious or personally identifiable content. Identity & Access SAML-based SSO, SCIM provisioning, two-factor authentication, session management and domain claiming keep your workspace secure. Privacy Principles We don't sell your data. We don't use customer data to train AI models. Your data belongs to you, and we provide tools to manage it. Privacy & Terms Privacy Policy How we collect, use and protect your personal information when you use Slack services. Terms of Service The agreement between you and Slack governing your use of our platform and services. Cookie Policy How we use cookies and similar technologies to provide, customise and improve our services. Data Processing Our data processing addendum for customers who need to comply with GDPR and other regulations. Security questions? Our team is here to help with your security and compliance needs. Collaboration Project Management Integrations Intelligence Collaboration Bring people, projects, knowledge and culture under one roof. # Channels Collaborate in real time with transparent conversations. Create channels around teams, projects or anything else. SC Slack Connect Turn partners into team members and break down boundaries, with secure collaboration right in Slack. H Huddles Work together in real time through audio and video meetings, including screen sharing. C Clips Share audio ideas or screen recordings with clips — all without leaving Slack. M Messaging Chat with your team in real time. Share files, react with emojis, and keep conversations organised. E Enterprise Scale securely with features designed for large organisations with complex needs. Project Management Keep projects on track without leaving the conversation. T Templates Start any task fast with ready-to-use templates. On Enterprise+, publish custom templates for your company. Ca Canvas Create rich, flexible docs with text, files, images and videos directly in a Slack canvas. L Lists Collaboratively manage projects and organise tasks in Slack lists. Track progress without switching tools. F File Sharing Bring files into the flow of work. Share, comment and collaborate on documents without leaving Slack. Integrations & Automation Connect your tools and automate your workflows. 2.6K Apps & Integrations Choose from over 2,600 apps in the Slack App Directory — from Salesforce, Jira, Google Drive, ChatGPT and more. WF Workflow Builder Automate routine tasks and processes directly in Slack, no coding required. Build with drag-and-drop simplicity. AP Agentic Platform Customise, extend and unify your tech stack in Slack. Deploy custom functions on Slack's secure infrastructure. CS Custom Workflow Steps Let developers bring org-specific systems into workflows with Slack APIs and custom steps. Intelligence Tap into your company's collective knowledge to work smarter. AI Slack AI Catch up instantly with channel and thread summaries, schedule daily recaps and take huddle notes automatically. SB Slackbot Your personal AI agent for work that knows you and your team. It adapts to your style, finds what you need and helps get work done faster. AF Agentforce Ask an agent to analyse customer data, draft emails, provide recommendations on sales opportunities and more. ES Enterprise Search Search all your company's third-party apps, data sources and conversations from a single, AI-powered search bar. WG AI Workflow Generation Build workflows from a single prompt with the power of Slack AI and Workflow Builder combined. DR Daily Recaps Get a daily digest of what's happening across all of your teams and projects, delivered right to you. Ready to get started? Try Slack free — no credit card required.
